leads.name: Castle Ward yew terraces (Ancient Yew Group 2732)
leads.reason: Three-rowed yew avenue on the terraces, 60 trees in 1890s, biggest 430 cm at 120 cm (2000-05) and 391 cm (TROI 2010); recovering from a 1998 crown reduction. An avenue: blocked as one point unless one named yew is pinned.
